chapters.title: Chapter 65: Physically Entering the Dimensional Hourglass
paragraphs: "How did you know?" That was her greatest secret. When she had been in the academy, she had seen a professor from the middle realm use something called Aura. It fascinated her—how can something be so powerful? But her hopes were crushed by the words of the professor telling everyone that those in the lower realm could never learn this.

But she never gave up and tried and tried. On the day she had decided to defy her fate by trying to kill a monster in the forbidden mist forest, hoping to get its core to level up, while coming close to dying, it was not all worthless, as she learned to form Aura during that fight. But even then, she wasn’t able to defeat that monstrosity.
And even now, after 5 years, she doesn’t think she can kill that monster. She would fare much better against it, but kill it—she still doesn’t think she can do it.

Leon told her about the fact that his system is an upgraded version of theirs, and he can see all her information with just a thought. But he didn’t know where the limit of information lies, as it had only been a short time since he found out about this.

She accepted his explanation. Still, this ability of his seemed useful to her. The power to know your opponent—that was deadly. And if it worked on monsters, future fights with monsters in the mist forest would be much easier.

’I had decided that enrolling Leon in the academy would be the best thing to do before, as they have people from the middle domain running it and a headmaster who seems unfathomable, as all the professors and teachers cower at just her glance.’

Previously, she didn’t know why that was, as they shouldn’t be that afraid of her. But after knowing about the different realms, she believes the headmaster might be from an even higher domain than them, or just a powerful individual.
’But now I feel they are not worthy to have my Leon as their student. I have to deal with paperwork to cancel out his admission.’
She left him in a hurry. She also had decided to prepare a few surprises for him, seeing his strength.
Leon reached his luxurious room once again.
He closed the door shut once inside.

Along the way, he regretted quite a lot for stopping his master’s advances. He had never done it, and after reading the book written by Lin Fang, he was even more curious and excited because of how heavenly the experience Lin Fang had described in his book.
He had never thought about having of harem of his own, but that holy book had aroused a desire in him that he had never known; he built his own harem of beautiful and lovely women of his own.
What is the point of having so much potential if he can’t fulfill his own wishes?
And he had decided his master would be the first member of his harem.
Still, he looked like a kid right now compared to the master. His master doesn’t mind, but he did feel a bit weird about it.
’Huh, why can’t I just grow up like before in the dungeon after merging with the orb? It would be so nice.’
He knew it would be torturous instead to hold out for even a year. He can’t do it—he wouldn’t be able to endure it until then.
A thought had come to his mind. He doesn’t know if it would work or not.

It was still around 2 pm. He had around 7 hours before he had to go for dinner. In terms of time inside his dimensional hourglass, it would be around a year. And if he counted the time after coming back from dinner, in total, he had around a little more than two years.
He had never tried to enter the dimension with his physical body. It was a separate dimension, so in theory, he should be able to enter it.
A smile appeared on his face, imagining what his master’s face would be like once she saw him all grown up once again in just the next day.

But if it didn’t work, then he doesn’t care about the morals of his previous world; he looks around 16, an adult in this world. Why should he bind himself with the morality of his previous world? To reject his beautiful master would be blasphemy to him.
He had made up his mind, but he didn’t mind giving it a try.
He still doesn’t know how, but he can think it would require mana. While learning to teleport small things, he did learn some basic ideas of how a portal would work.
He remembered the dungeon he had entered for his class awakening. That was a separate dimension. So to enter his own dimension, he had to enter through a portal or teleportation.
He didn’t dwell on it for long and took out the hourglass instead.

The hourglass floated on his hand with its brilliance and the same sight of black sand defying gravity, moving from sideways. From a distance, it could be mistaken for a normal hourglass, but once close, anyone can see how mysterious the hourglass is.
Instead of traveling with his consciousness, Leon started pouring his mana into it. He only started with just a little, but it got sucked in like nothing.

Leon continued with increased intensity. He had so much mana that he was confident in quenching the thirst of the little hourglass. He can also feel the ripple of space around him. With his space control, he knew a portal was about to form here.

He continued. Half a minute had passed and the hourglass was still sucking his mana. A shimmering silver-white portal was forming in front of him, but right now it was not complete and quite unstable.
’Fucking hell, I had poured 600 mana. Is this a black hole?’

For the first time, Leon felt that his mana was not enough. But he still kept going, and he even started to feel a bit tired due to the strain caused to his body by using such a large amount of mana in such a short period.
’You monster, stop it! Don’t suck it so hard—I would lose consciousness.’
He paused his thought for a moment. It was necessary.
But the thing was, he can’t stop it.
It was about to reach 1000 mana—nearly all his reserve. If he hadn’t leveled up, he would be unconscious right now. He felt relieved he had leveled up.

And thankfully, once it reached 1000 mana, it stopped sucking his mana. It was quite a dangerous experience for him, as he couldn’t stop the supply of his mana once he started giving it. But luckily, he didn’t pass out.
Leon can feel that the portal is complete. He didn’t wait even for a second and entered, fearing it would vanish before he could even enter.
This time, he didn’t feel the least bit weird entering the portal. Instead, it felt a bit relaxing to him now.
Once inside, he found himself in the same exact place as before he had left. The portal behind him closed after a few seconds after he exited the portal.
He remembered the time it only opened for 20 seconds.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Journey to become commando
paragraphs: Leon looked around. Everything looked the same as he had left it, even the small mountain was destroyed as he had done so. He didn’t understand how his consciousness only entered, but the mountain was destroyed.
Was it truly only his conscience or something else?
He didn’t think he would get an answer for it right now, so he moved his focus to the thing that was different from before.
Here wasn’t anything like the outside. The mana here felt abundant. He walked in it like finding the shade of a tree from scorching heat. He felt refreshed and rejuvenated.
The mana he had lost was recovering faster than ever. Usually, it would take him fifteen minutes to recover his mana fully, but now he felt he could do so in only five minutes.
At first, he had thought, how can he recover so much of his mana so fast, even in the outside world? He had 1000+ mana, and it took him only fifteen minutes.

The information regarding this is mentioned in Lin Fang’s journey was quite simple. The rate at which a person would recover depended mainly on the rank of affinity of the element a person had. In case a person had a rank 5 affinity, he would recover his mana faster than someone with a rank 4 affinity.
But if the person had more than one affinity, their recovery speed would increase even more.

He was delighted to know this fact. For someone like him, who had an affinity for every element with massive rank 7 affinity, he didn’t even know how many elements in total there really were, but he could count more than ten.

So his quick recovery was justifiable. It seemed in the outside world, because of a lack of mana in the atmosphere, his recovery took much longer, but in here, it had gone from fifteen to five—a massive jump.
But there are other ways to increase the recovery speed, too, but they are rare because of how guarded these techniques are by powerful organizations, sects, kingdoms, empires, and individuals.
Lin Fang was only able to get his hands on an uncommon-ranked mana recovery technique during his journey, which was also not a technique of a high-ranked sect.
Leon could understand why mana recovery techniques are so guarded. It would define the outcome of the battle, giving one with the technique a massive advantage.
’But I don’t think I have to worry about these mana recovery techniques any time soon.’

The thought of trying to absorb the mana from the atmosphere didn’t even enter his mind, as it was like poison to one’s body, because of its unrefined form. It was common knowledge that Seraphine had told him before even awakening.
Despite the techniques, the most important thing was one’s affinity, which gave them the natural advantage, and he had all the advantage he could get.
Only after waiting for a few minutes, his mana had recovered fully. He didn’t think he had to worry about mana recovery here.

He had around 291 days to train before he had to go for dinner. He would have started with the space element, but he had decided to go with the life element for today, because of his fight with his lovely master the next day.
He would continue practicing space elements tomorrow.
He started by trying to imagine life in his head about life. It was connected to vitality, the thing that keeps life going...

Despite that, it took half an hour to manifest the first strand of life element. Even space element took less than that, whose reason he might guess was because of coming in contact with portals and experiencing it firsthand. His inventory connected to his soul was also made out of a space element.
But for the life element, he had never seen anyone use it and experience it himself.
After the first manifestation, it got much easier.

For the practice, he took out the corpses of smaller wolves, which were in much better shape than others, because in the first few fights, he only used precise strikes to kill, unlike after merging with the orb, when he just blasted them to pieces.
The corpse was still fresh.
He practiced by making small cuts and healed the cuts using his life energy created by mana.
Time started to pass quickly.
3 months have passed by like nothing.
During his time, he had to sleep and eat like every other human.
The time he had to practice was much less, but the progress he was making was more than twice as fast, too, by which he understood that the environment here had something to do with that.
For the food, he had to thank his spoon of infinite soup, which produced a balanced, nutritious, delicious soup. The taste grew repetitive over time, but it never tasted bad. He enjoyed the soup.

He did try to cook up a piece of monster using the fire he had created using his magic. There wasn’t any seasoning, so he tried to mix it with the soup and eat it, but it was horrible. He didn’t even swallow it and spat it out because of how bad it was.

The meat wasn’t that burned, he could differentiate it between a piece of charcoal and meat he cooked for himself, so he understood it had something to do with the meat itself. After that day, he was content with his delicious soup every day.
There wasn’t much to experiment with, simple elements, as life for him. His aim was to reach at least the stage when he would regrow limbs.
The progress was much smoother than he had expected. As his control over the life energy increased, the cost of the mana decreased, and even his healing speed increased.
But the reason for the stop was something unexpected he hadn’t thought about.
In just three months, the clothes he was wearing had become too tight for him to wear, which shouldn’t be normal.
He had to take his clothes off because of it, and he was only in his underwear right now, which he had made sure the material used was elastic, because the last time in the dungeon, it was tight.
Very tight.
Inside the dungeon, every step feels like his underwear’s trying to start a civil war down there.
But his accustomance to brutal pain held his will firm even in that crisis.
Still, his choice was clear; he didn’t want to experience that feeling ever again.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Journey to become commando—The End
paragraphs: He created a mirror out of his ice element in front of him and could see that his height had increased by at least three inches. Now he was much taller.
There was only one answer to this mystery in his mind.
Life Element.
He couldn’t explain what was happening in proper terms because of his lack of knowledge, but one thing was clear to him—as he used life element, the growth rate of his body increased.

He could only assume that it must be due to a life element, as this was the only thing he could think of. If he ever met someone who also had an affinity with the life element, this mystery might be solved.
But for now, he could only praise the fact of how fast he was growing. He decided to open his status screen to check something.
A shimmering, transparent golden screen appeared in front of him, revealing his information.
[Character Information]
[Name: Leon]
[Level: 6]
[Class: Elemental Paragon(SSS)]
[Age: 10 ( Soul Age: 26)]
[Race: Human]
[Cultivation: Apprentice Rank]
[Affinity: All (Rank 7)]
[Strength: 33]
[Agility: 34]
[Stamina: 34]
[Intelligence: 150]
[Skills: King’s Touch (Level 1- Epic), Lightning Bolt (Level 1 - Common)]
[Technique: Mana Body Enhancement(Adept Rank)]
He looked at his stats, particularly his physical age, which was still 10, despite the massive change happening in his body.
’Hmm, it seems whatever had happened had only increased the growth rate of the body, not the actual age.’
There was still more than six months left, so he continued his training while only in underwear, which felt fine for now.
Six months had passed now.
Leon was standing in front of a square-shaped mirror made out of ice. He had the control to make it look good.
But what mattered right now wasn’t the designed mirror.
In these past six months, other than the fact of massive growth he had in controlling life elements and using them to heal either himself or others, he had found one other sinister use.
The ability to suck out of life enery out of living beings, he had turned corpse he was pracitisn a dried up stick many time, but it got back to previous when he healed it using his life engery
This ability can heal his body at time at the same with while even recovering his mana in the process, and one can’t forget its deadly effect of turning people into practical undead.
He knew if he sucked too much life force out they would die at the end.
His focus was on his naked body standing in front of the mirror made out of ice.
His first focus was on his face. He had lost the cute, childish charm he had before, and right now, he could only be defined as handsome.

His hair, which once fell only up to his shoulder, was now even longer, reaching his upper back, below the shoulder blade. He could see in the reflection that it suited him quite well, so he would leave it as it was.

Growth wasn’t just height. He appeared as before—a lean body, broad shoulders. Muscle on his body increased in just the perfect areas. He had defined abs, and most importantly, the size of things had also improved.
Even before he had a good size, but now it was even bigger and thicker.

He had worried when he had grown three inches in just three months, but now, even after the sixth month, he had grown only another three inches. Most of the growth was at the start, and at the end, growth had slowed down.
But even then, it was still not normal.

But he was quite happy with the results. He stood at six feet tall, an inch taller than his master. Now he felt much more confident in handling her in the future, and looked forward to his moves now, because he wasn’t going to go easy on her.

As for the other use of life element, it was sinister but useful, so he would try not to use it in front of other people if possible. But it was an overpowered ability that required almost no amount of mana for him to perform.
And that was not all. He felt like he could regrow his limbs if they were destroyed.
His goal was accomplished.
But hadn’t tried it on himself—only on the wolf corpse. But it worked as the obliterated leg grew back perfectly as new.

But it did take a lot of mana. For the small wolf he was practicing on, it took him about 600 mana, only because he had better control over the element. However, he did think that for his own arm, it would take less, as it does depend on the size of the thing.
As for the other healing—deep cuts or even broken bones—a hundred mana was enough for him to heal them. It depends on how severe the wounds are.
He was confident in this one because he had tried it on himself. It was painful but worth it, but he didn’t go as crazy as to destroy his whole arm.
He came out of the dimension and was now back inside his room, naked, behind him was the silver white portal.
He had decided to go full command only after the next month because if not, the war would be waged again, and he didn’t want to experience it again.
He felt drained once again, as he had to use 1000 mana once again to create another portal for him to go back.
’I did create water using my water element to take a bath from time to time, but I still want to take a nice shower using soap and shampoo.’

He remembered to take basic things with him once he went back inside his dimension in physical form. He even thought about building a house inside where he could rest when he went back. Sleeping on the floor wasn’t hard for him with his strong body. He didn’t feel cold or anything.
’But nothing could beat the comfort of a soft bed.’

He went to the bathroom attached to his room and took a nice shower. There was a big bath inside too, but he didn’t have enough time to take the bath right now and much preferred being bathed by the help of lovely maids inside the mansion.
It was just too relaxing that way.
He was just wrapping a towel around his waist when a knock on the door was heard.
Knock knock
He didn’t just outright open the door like the last time. First, he heard who it was behind the door. He wished it were Kaela, as it would be much easier to arrange the clothes for him with her help.
"Young Master, it’s me, Kaela. Come with me. It’s time for dinner."
A smile appeared on his face, hearing Kaela’s voice, as everything would be much simpler now. He opened the door.
Both of their eyes locked for a moment. He could see the slight blush on Kaela’s face. There was shock on her face at first, but she seemed to have calmed down after a few seconds.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: New Looks
paragraphs: Kaela didn’t need to come to invite young master Leon for dinner as any normal maid could do that job, but after the lunch, the time she had spent together with Lady Seraphine, she was way too cheerful. She was even giggling like a fool from time to time, saying young master Leon’s name, saying ’my Leon loves me’, ’my dear Leon loves me’, ’my cute disciple loves me’.
Even though she was acting like a little girl, the fact remained that she was much happier, so Kaela had to thank young master Leon for that.

If she hadn’t known her for years, she would have thought she had fallen in love with young master Leon, but she denied the idea. She might be crazy sometimes, but she won’t go that far when she calls him family. He was too young, despite his appearance.
But when he opened the door, there was a handsome man with long white hair, mystical eyes, standing naked in front of her, only with a towel.
A few seconds of looking at the man was enough for her to tell that it was the mysterious young master Leon.
Only the word mysterious could define the changes in him for her now, as there wasn’t even a class awakening ceremony to blame for his growth now.
But what made her blush was not the fact that he was standing with only a towel in front of her, looking majestic, but the fact of the big, bold outline on his towel he was wearing.
It had shocked her.
She didn’t wait for an order and said it herself.
"Young master Leon, you just wait here. I will prepare clothes for you in just five minutes."

"But wait, Kaela, you don’t know what size would fit me. Let me come back in a minute." He was about to close the door to take his measurements, but her confident voice sounded before it could happen.

"Young master Leon, I have taken care of clothes for my lady for years," she continued, her tone a bit annoyed. "I had seen enough of you, young master, to bring the clothes that would fit you perfectly. You just trust me and wait inside your room."

Leon heard her confident voice and decided to go back inside his room, closing the door and waiting for her to bring the clothes for him to wear. He had detected the bit of annoyance in her voice for some reason that he couldn’t guess, so he ignored it.

The reason Kaela was annoyed was because of the sudden sight she had acted in such a way that a knight such as herself shouldn’t act in front of her master. As a person who aspired to be a perfect knight, that was unacceptable.
Knock Knock
Another knock came right when the clock ticked five whole minutes.
He opened the door and saw Kaela, the short black-haired woman with black eyes, standing with folded clothes.
He took the clothes from her hand and shut the door, not before showing her his gratitude through simple words.
"Thank you, Kaela, you are a lifesaver."

Kaela didn’t understand why he was saying she had saved his life, which wasn’t true, but it seemed he meant to show appreciation. It made her feel great as her commander wouldn’t praise someone; only when she found something to be exceptional, she would shower her praise, which suited her role as commander.
She had been praised only a few times.
’But it feels good to be appreciated for simple things.’
He had gotten used to the fancy clothes he had to wear here, the shirt. Pants were similar to the pants on earth, but with only minor details, but the shirts they gave him a pure aristocratic feel.

He wore the high-collared white brocade shirt, its silky fabric shimmering faintly with intricate woven patterns. The sleeves were wide and flowing, cinched tightly at the wrists with buttoned cuffs, giving him an air of noble elegance.
Paired with it were sleek, black satin trousers—fitted and glossy—emphasizing his tall, statuesque frame. The entire outfit clung to him with a quiet grace, regal yet untouched by excess.
Image here.
He looked at himself in the mirror. Despite the different styles, these clothes slap on him.
He walked out the door now. Kaela scanned his figure and checked that the clothes fit him perfectly. She was satisfied, but there was another thought in her mind, seeing how he looked.
’Young master Leon looked more noble than nobles.’
She believed even their crown prince would fade in his presence. She wasn’t the one to exaggerate, as that’s what she believed.

Along the way to the dining hall, she didn’t forget to thank him for whatever he had done to make her lady so happy, but she knew he would have been more truthful to her. It did make her curious about young master Leon, as he looked like a man now. She had seen him just six hours ago, but now he had grown so much.
But she was not the one to bring her nose to her master’s business, so she followed him to the entrance of the dining hall and waited outside.
Leon entered the dining hall. He noticed his master’s elbow resting on the table, her face slumped on both hands, her cheek squished by her hand, making her look adorable.
Then she noticed their eyes met. There was a hint of surprise in her eyes, not the shock he would get.
She didn’t wait for him to reach his seat, and he could see her running toward him, while a smile spread on her face, her hands spread out. She looked gorgeous, welcoming him in such a way.

Leon didn’t shy away and opened his arms wide. Only a second after, her soft body hit him, and she felt her arms around his back. He also wrapped his arms around her body, which seemed much smaller now compared to before.
Both embraced each other in silence. It wasn’t quiet silence but a silence filled with their bond, love, and understanding.
Minutes passed, but no one cared. They don’t know when they separated from each other, and when they did, Seraphine’s voice broke the loving silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Confession
paragraphs: "Leon, you look so handsome right now. Your master was surprised to see you like this. I do prefer the cute version of my disciple the most," her tone became teasing as she continued while her hand traced above his abs through the white shirt he was wearing. "But I don’t mind having a handsome and hot disciple like now."

Leon could feel her hand tracing his abs through his shirt, but he wasn’t going to let her have the upper hand now when he was more ready than ever to face her and take her down. He would make her the first member of his future harem.
He grabbed her hand and pulled her onto his body as she leaned on him. His hand wrapped around her waist, grabbing it as if it belonged to him.
Seraphine wasn’t much surprised by this, as she had expected something like this to happen in the future, but it happened sooner than she had expected. She was loving every moment of it.

To her, considering him her only family, it couldn’t just stop at being master and disciple. She wanted all of him, like how her father and mother were—loving each other, sharing every part of themselves with one another. This was what she considered a proper family.

And she knew after spending little time with him that he was the only one she wanted as her family. Her cute little lovely disciple—she wanted him to grow up fast. As if her wish had come true, it happened.
Finally.
Soon she will marry him.
She didn’t feel the least bit guilty about his age despite the fact that she didn’t know about his two lives before. She could never take advantage of him. Her conscience was clear to her.

But now she didn’t even have to worry about it as she knew he was 26 years old mentally, and now he looked at least 18. His boldness could be from the fact that his previous world morality wasn’t holding him back anymore.
Even if his body didn’t have the strange growth, she believed he would have dealt with the obstacle that was stopping him himself and accepted her fully.
"Hmph! Just because you’ve grown a bit taller than your master doesn’t mean you can treat your master like this. You need to be punished for such blatant disregard."
Despite the way she was talking in a playful tone, Leon could feel her hand wrapped around his back. If she wanted to act, he didn’t mind playing along.
His hand around her waist pulled her even tighter in his embrace as he continued.
"What might be the punishment, master?"
She already knew what she wanted from him right now, so the answer came just as he asked.
"I demand a kiss from you, my dear disciple, for the disrespect you have shown me."

Leon didn’t answer. He just showed a warm smile, which made Seraphine’s heart skip a few beats. Her disciple had become more attractive than she had imagined, but looks alone weren’t enough to impress her. The fact that it was her same Leon made her heart beat loudly in her chest, and the fact that she knew this smile meant he was going to kiss her.
Finally.
She had envisioned this moment for years.
’I love my Leon so much.’
She closed her eyes to feel the moment, and her lips parted, inviting him to kiss her on her lips.

For a moment, Leon just stopped and looked at his beautiful master in his arms, inviting him to kiss her. She looked most beautiful right now. How could he not love such a woman like that? He did feel lustful sometimes, but right now, first before anything, he wanted to let her know how much he loves her.
A woman who had changed the sarcastic young man into a man capable of trusting and loving someone else through her love and care.
Despite what the future held for him, he felt most peaceful in this moment.
Instead of feeling his soft lips on her own, she felt them on her forehead. A warmth spread across her body.
But the next words she heard made her whole body tremble in his arms.
"I love you, Seraphine."
Seraphine’s eyes shot open wide. She looked at Leon, looking at her with a bright smile and eyes filled with love.
She wanted this moment to be memorable, and nothing could be more memorable to her than Leon confessing his love for her.
He didn’t even use her title as a master, which made her feel even more delighted, as their love had no boundaries now. Leon was truly hers now.
The warmth she had felt when he said he loved her was the greatest thing she had ever felt. Once wasn’t nearly enough—she wanted to hear it every day for the rest of her life.
"Say it again." The swirl in her amethyst eyes was back.
Leon had seen these eyes, the very eyes that made him feel it would swallow him whole, but now he understood what they represented.
It just showed her endless love for him, not madness, not craziness, just pure, endless love.
He started to love those eyes now.
Leon repeated his confession again for her as she seemed to love it quite a lot. Every time he confessed to her, her body would tremble in his arms.
He found that quite cute, so he didn’t mind.
10 minutes...

He would have lost count if not for his superhuman memory about how many times he had said he loved her. If it were 10, he would have thought she loved it too much, so she wanted to hear it again and again, and would have waved it off. But he took back what he said about when he said she wasn’t crazy, as with endless love, her craziness got added as taxes.
It was not something he had control over and had to deal with whether or not he would enjoy it or not.
For the 69th time, he said:
"I love you, Seraphine."
The only thing that kept him going was her cute reaction to her body in his arms.
He released a sigh of relief seeing that she hadn’t asked him to say it again, and the swirling in her eyes was nearly gone now.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Built Different
paragraphs: Leon reached his room, still half-hard and frustrated thanks to the little moment he’d shared with Master. Her touch, her voice—it had stirred more than just his feelings. He stood there for a second, debating. His most loyal comrade, always on standby, never judged him—just ready to grip, stroke, and finish the job.
He glanced at his hand. ’Yeah... you’ve served me well, old friend.’
But then he hesitated.
He remembered the last time.
One session turned into two. Then five. Then... Almost a day passed inside his time dimension.

His stamina wasn’t human anymore to begin with, besides, after unlocking the Life element, something inside him changed—something primal and relentless. He just needed a bit of mana from his large reserve. He didn’t justjerk offanymore. Hewaged waron his own damn body.
He had become asex machine—the kind of freak who could go twelve rounds with nothing but imagination and lotion.
The kind of guy who had toschedule breaksso his legs didn’t go numb.
And sleep?
Sleep was the only thing that could knock him out... and even that had to fight for dominance.
With a frustrated sigh, he turned away from temptation.
Tonight, his dick would stay undefeated... but untouched.
For now.

He had gotten used to the habit of training whenever he had free time, but today he had decided to go with physical training, which he hadn’t done for a long time. Even still, his body remained perfect, but to calm his raging dragon, he had to do it.
Before moving back to train his space element, which he was still not satisfied with, he wanted enough control so he could cast the spell in less than a second.

And not just that—he was going to train with the sword he had earned inside the dungeon. He would try to wield the epic-ranked emo sword he had gotten as a spin, but he wasn’t sure if it would work or not.

In terms of pure skill in wielding his dagger, he was sure he had surpassed Seraphine, her master, because she would get her teaching done after coming back from him. He had so much to train and practice everything he had learned from her.
He wouldn’t have time in real life much because of her brutal training, but one hour every day on weekends, inside the dimension, was his routine he never missed.

But he had realized the shortcomings of weapons like daggers. They could give you an advantage in specific conditions, but the sword seemed the most optimal weapon to him; it had control, more damage, reach, and he had an epic-ranked sword to wield, too, so there was more reason for him to train with it.
He had forgotten to ask for an extra bed and bathtub for other things he would need for leisure time inside the dimension besides just training.

For now, he had decided to take the king-sized luxurious bed inside his room, and the big bathtub inside his bathroom, along with soap and shampoo. He had his trusted soup for the food—it had a perfect balance of nutrition and tasted delicious. He could make do with it.
He also took all the portions of the snacks he would get every month, like cookies, candies, and chips, which could last for two months. It would be a nice change in taste once in a while.
He had also found quite a lot of new pairs of luxurious clothes inside his new wardrobe in his new sizes. He believed it was Kaela’s work. He appreciated her in his heart and took them too.
He stored all the things inside his inventory.

Once again, he took the hourglass out of his inventory. He started pouring out his mana inside the hourglass, and he had noticed a slight difference in his body. Unlike previous times, this time he didn’t feel like he was reaching the point of passing out. He did feel a bit weaker.
But he felt like he was getting used to the feeling of using mana almost to the limit. He would have never found this if not for the hourglass, so he had to thank the little devourer for that.
While he had drained his mana time inside the dimension in his conscious form, he felt weak, yes, but never to the point of passing out.
And the feeling was always the same as before, no matter how many times it happened.
Once he passed through the portal and reached inside, he started the physical exercise first.
His sleep was fucked—just like back on Earth—but for an entirely different reason this time.
Back then, it was stress, late-night gaming, or existential dread.
But now, because of his godly treasure.

Normal physical exercise had no effect on him. He understood that quite quickly. He had to do push-ups for half an hour just to smell his own sweat, which was strangely fragrant. He didn’t even question it now. His body had become a different thing after the merging with the orb.
He was just built different now.
He could see the large rock, which would help in training, but he instead did something else.
TheBlade of Convenient Sharpness.

It appeared in a quiet flash—long, sleek, and deadly elegant. A matte black blade in a sheath of matching darkness, with a polished silver handle so perfectly balanced it looked like it belonged in a noble’s collection.
Leon tried to catch it with his hand while summoning it from his inventory, but due to the weight, it dropped on the rocky ground with a loud sound.
Boom!

Leon wasn’t feeling any form of threat coming from it this time, which was to be expected as he tried to wield it inside the dungeon after merging with the orb. It was the same, no rejection, but it was too heavy for him to even lift.
He muttered, looking at the blade, "Definitely better than those rocks. Would work as a lifelong replacement for dumbbells."
He felt a slight pressure on his body and emotions, such as anger and displeasure, from it.
It didn’t understand but felt insulted being compared to rocks.
’For how useful this sword had been so far, it sure had an attitude—like it knew it was hot stuff. Still, at least it wasn’t whining like a brat whose candy he’d just yeeted into a volcano.’
But this sword did fascinate him, as this was the first treasure that showed such emotion openly.
The orb felt sentient to some degree, but not at this level. As for the dimension hourglass, the highest ranked treasure he had, it was quiet as day. He had never detected anything from it.

paragraphs: Leon’s hand moved to pick up the epic-ranked sword, which was in a matte black sheath, but this time he was using his adept rank mana enhancement, mana channeling through his arm, making him many times stronger. As he tried to pick it up, even with that, he was barely able to lift the blade off the ground with both hands holding the blade.

It was still too heavy for him to move. He had even tried to take out the blade, thinking without the sheath it might be less heavy, but he wasn’t even able to make it budge even an inch from the sheath.
He didn’t feel any rejection from it, just that he lacked the physical prowess to even lift up the sword with his hands, and couldn’t even unsheath it right now.
’A perfect replacement for doing deadlifts.’

He continued doing various types of physical exercises, like doing pushups while a huge rock pressed against his back, doing deadlifts with the epic rank blade, running while connecting himself with massive rocks using his ice element.
Unlike before, these workouts pushed him to his limits. He could feel his stamina draining, his muscles aching, and sweat pouring down his body. And for once, it feltexhilarating.

Seraphine had told him that doing physical training was also a surefire way to increase one’s physical stats; however, this method was slow and tiring, so most people didn’t rely on it much besides the classes that had a physical combat focus.

Her class, Lightning Knight, was a mix of both, so she trained her body regularly. Even with all these years of training, her stats hadn’t increased by more than 5 through physical training, but it was still a good improvement for her.
As those 5 stats made a big difference in actual fights.
And Leon had also decided to add physical training to his routine, but his main focus would always be on the elemental training which he had a big advantage.
Finally, his raging dragon had calmed down, so he would now focus on training with space affinity.

He had around 9 months inside before the morning would arrive once again on the outside, which would be the time for his fight with his beautiful master, and then finally his date with her, which he was even more excited about than the fight.

He had no intention of holding back in tomorrow’s fight. He knew his master would be upset if he did. She would rather lose than see him fight while holding back. He didn’t know what the outcome of the fight would be. He would have to face her Lightning Aura for the first time.
He was excited to see how it would be if it were as powerful as Lin Fang had described the concepts to be.

Even then, he couldn’t see her winning. With his training sessions, he was confident in bringing his control over space elements to a new degree, especially when training her in physical form had much faster results for some reason.
Inside an unknown space, a being with white eyes was looking at the screen in front of it with full curiosity and excitement, as it was her only piece of entertainment.

"No matter how many times I see it, it still feels unreal, my future master has two more affinities, and not just any affinities, one of the rarest and strongest affinities, Life and Space, and their rank wasn’t low, it was definitely either rank 6 or 7."
She felt pissed from the past due to her confinement she wasn’t able to detect which rank the elements actually were besides the time element, because of her deep understanding of time.

"Even if all his elements are rank 6 besides the Time, holding rank 6 Life, space, ice, wind, and rank 7 Time, they are enough to make him an absolute genius even in the divine realm. He has the potential to become one of the @!#$%#, like the lame bastard, The Keeper of the Dimension."
"hehe~"
She imagined that when her master reached his potential, both of them would gang up on that man and beat him up as her revenge.
"That wouldn’t be all, would it? We will take all the treasure he has. He is most famous for hoarding treasure, and even divine rank treasures are in his collections, for letting him live, hehe!"
Just imagining that sight of him bowing his head in front of her and her master made her feel ecstatic.
"The future is going to be exciting with my master’s ~"
She went silent for a moment, and she remembered a sight she had witnessed when her master visited previously.
Her steady white eyes shook for the first time.
’A whole day! A whole fucking day’
’Beating his own meat’

She believed one had to be a freak of nature to be jacking for a whole day continuously. She even lost count of how many times he had painted that stone floor white. She believed it would have easily been enough to paint a few doors or even a wall.
How could that be even possible? After his stamina had given up on him in a few hours, he used his life energy to replenish his stamina, which would have been fine if it were only once.
But how the fuck did he do it again and again and his body looked alive and didn’t collapse, making him take a retreat for weeks.
She was genuinely baffled. It shouldn’t have been possible to begin with, but she couldn’t help but have to believe it even when it felt so broken as an ability.

Besides the strange eyes, which she had never seen in any of the rankings of mystical eyes, his body also seemed to hold some secret. He had even grown taller over a short period, which was also strange to her.
She couldn’t help but feel delighted.

’How long has it been since I had seen something so mysterious and interesting? I have all the time in the world. I would try to find out about his strange eyes and body, which were always perfect, even when he didn’t do much physical training previously. He should have at least a bit of change.’
He hadn’t gained his divinity, so he should have had some effect on him as a human, but he didn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: New Gains
paragraphs: She was a bit disappointed too.
As her master had such an attractive appearance, even then he pleasured himself for a whole freaking day.
"Master should have done it with a beautiful woman; it would have been much more exciting to watch. I feel sorry for him."
But she believed in her master that he would do the right thing and next time would bring a lady with him, and give her a show of her life.
She even felt a bit excited and fearful about when they would meet, which meant he would become her master.
She considered herself very pretty.
Her wild imagination, the moment he met her, he would pounce on her...
9 months had passed now,
Leon had woken up from peaceful sleep on his soft, luxurious bed. he knew it was time for him to go back now.
He stretched his body a few times and summoned the portal back to his room using 1000 mana. A draining experience like ever before.

The training this time had been more fruitful than he had ever imagined. Besides the fact that he was able to integrate all of his teaching of the dagger to the new weapon sword, it still lacked the touch of real battle, which could make all the moves smooth and seamless, like he did with his dagger.

Besides that, he had a massive improvement in his control over the space element now. His spatial freeze was more powerful, took less mana, and could be cast in just half a second. The same would be said for spatial distortion, and even the range had increased from 10 meters to 15 meters, with the same speed for both of these abilities.

He was confident in teleporting himself 10 meters around him, as he was able to do so with large rocks he had done countless times, but had never tried with himself, as the thought of his body disappearing in a strange space did make him a bit cautious.
He had decided to try it inside the conscious form of his dimension. There was still time left, so he sat on the floor and entered the dimension through his connection.

He stood on the rocky plane with determined and focused eyes. Taking a deep breath, he used his mana as he was ready to teleport 10 meters in front of him. His body blinked from its place in a second after using his mana, as he appeared in the same exact place he had intended.
But he wasn’t standing straight. His hand was on his stomach, and the feeling wasn’t great at all. He felt he could vomit at any moment.
He recovered after 2 whole minutes.

He started teleporting again and again, as his body blinked from place to place. He was trying to make himself get used to the feeling of teleporting. To teleport currently at 10 meters, it would take him 30 mana, about the same as spatial distortion and spatial freeze when used for the maximum range.
It doesn’t take a lot of mana, but it does require a lot of practice and focus to pull it off.

If he counted the whole time, it took him more than a year to master this ability. There was one new ability he was currently working on, which was going to be overpowered besides the portal he was going to learn sooner or later, but it was not complete yet. He only had the idea. He hadn’t succeeded once.
The cost of using spatial awareness has also decreased quite a lot. It only took him 50 mana/second now to pull it off for a 100-meter range.
And he could use it 10 meters around him all the time, as his mana recovery would be higher than how much he would spend on it.

Previously, he wasn’t sure if the outcome of the battle between him and the master was clear, but now he was sure she had no chance against him. He didn’t know how she would react when she lost, but he was sure he couldn’t go easy on her, knowing her personality.

He walked out of his room and went toward the bath. He had to decide on a bath by being taken care of by lovely maids. It had been so long since he had done that, since most of the time he was inside the time dimension. It was a relaxing feeling. He wanted to experience it again.
While walking to the baths, the maids noticed, but they didn’t approach him like they used to, during the past three years, as living there they had become familiar.

He could see the curiosity burning in their eyes, all their eyes on him. It might be enough to make them guess about his real identity now, as he had now reached the height of 6 feet 1 inch (181cm) roughly, one inch taller than yesterday.
But since they had seen him yesterday, it would be around 8 whole inches to them.

From his previous short height, his eyes were already a giveaway that he was the same person who came here yesterday morning, but had become much older. Considering his other features, they could link him to young master Leon.
And he wasn’t wrong as he heard their whispers, which, strangely, every time would be loud enough for the actual person to hear.
Failing at hiding their whispers.
"Look, the one we assumed was young master Leon’s cousin now looks much older," one whispered. "He has the same mesmerizing eyes, we can’t be wrong."
The other one nodded to the words of the maid beside her.
"He is such a hottie, he looks like someone from the royal family," the previous maid pinched her cheek and continued.
"That’s true, but besides his eyes, didn’t he look too much like young master Leon, just older?"
"I can imagine our cute young master turning out to be as handsome as him," the other maid nodded to her words.
"Hmm Hmm, you are right!" another whispered. "Would he just be an older version of our young master Leon if not for his eyes?"
A mutual agreement.
Both made were quite suspicious of his identity now.
"Should we go and talk to him?"
Leon didn’t wait for them to finish their secret conversation, which could be heard from miles away. He approached one of them and said.
"Is the bath prepared?"

chapters.title: Chapter 74: A Nice Relaxing Bath
paragraphs: The maid, who was a bit stunned by the sudden approach, hurriedly led him to the bath with the other maid beside her. They were curious to ask him about his identity, but didn’t have the courage to do so.

The water was hot, steam rising as Leon stepped into the bath without a towel, naked. He didn’t bother covering up—he was used to this by now. The two maids were already waiting, kneeling at the edge of the pool with red cheeks.
This tall and ripped figure with a handsome face and long white hair made them even more nervous and shy than when they gave baths to young master Leon.
They dipped their sponges into the water, stealing quick glances at him. He leaned back against the side of the tub, spreading his arms out, legs open, giving them full access.

The first maid started with his chest, rubbing the sponge across his skin, trying not to stare at his cock resting half-submerged between his legs. The other moved behind him, working over his shoulders and down his back, but her eyes kept flicking downward every time he shifted.
It was too big for them to not notice. It made them blush, but they only tried to focus on cleaning his body.
Its size even scared them a bit.
During the bath, Leon felt relaxed, as it felt good to be taken care of like this once in a while.
The maid, seeing him so relaxed and comfortable lying there, his eyes closed, while letting them take care of everything, felt he was too similar to young master Leon.
Both of them, rubbing his flawless body with the sponge, looked at each other in their eyes and nodded, as they had decided to ask him.
"Young master, are you young master Leon?"

Leon heard their words and thought for a second, and decided to tell them the truth. He didn’t think anyone here would harm him, and they wouldn’t share these things with outsiders. Kaela had also mentioned that Seraphine would tell them the truth.
"Yes, I am."

After hearing his answer, their hands, which were a bit nervous at first, became steady. Now their facial expressions became comfortable, even as little young master Leon from before had become such a hot man now, as there was also the massive thing between his legs which they couldn’t help but glance at from time to time.
It was still thier young master Leon.

They didn’t ask how he suddenly looked like a proper adult, as they didn’t need to know that, but the fact remained in both their minds that he might have those needs now. It wasn’t unusual for maids to satisfy those needs in noble houses, but neither of them had ever done something like that.

Because working for Lady Seraphine, they had never been ordered to do any of that for any guest that had paid her lady a visit, or even stayed in the mansion. Well, for men, they usually didn’t even get to stay after whatever reason they came for.
As for women, they would only stay one or two days at most, but they never encountered such a situation. They even believed it would be her lady who had done these things.
But they still asked as knowing young master Leon as they believed he was special to the lady. They were not as nervous as before, having known him for three years.
"Young master Leon, do you want us to satisfy your s-sexual needs too?"
Hearing their words, Leon nearly drowned, the warm comfort in which he was trying to relax.
The offer did sound tempting, coming from two maids who looked quite decent, not even near the level of a master, but they looked good.
However, he had no intention of doing such a thing with them, so he refused their proposal.
Hearing his refusal, they released a sigh of relief as they were nervous. Still, there was also disappointment in their eyes.
After the bath was finished, Leon went toward the dining hall. He was fifteen minutes early today, but he didn’t mind waiting inside the hall for Seraphine as they finished their breakfast.
But to his surprise master was already waiting for him. The food was still getting arranged by the maid, but the master was sitting there.
He even felt like it was not the first time she had waited for him like this.
He made sure his footsteps were heard, and as he intended, Seraphine noticed him. Their eyes locked with each other, only one thing on their minds.
She rushed to him quickly and, reaching him, hugged him tightly as his arms were wide open for her to come. Leon also wrapped his arms tightly around her.

This scene made the maids working to prepare breakfast shocked for a minute or so. Their mouths agape, as their lady was hugging a handsome man who was a bit taller than her. This seemed too farfetched, as her lady had never shown any interest in many men, including those who had tried to court her, and even she had shown disgust to a few.
There were constant proposals, so it was known to everybody in the mansion that when someone tried to court her lady, they could even say she had no interest in men at all.
But now the same woman was hugging a man so passionately, without any care in the world. The genuine smile on her cold face made them realize it was real.
It only took them a few moments after seeing her smile to realize who the young man might be whose hair resembled young master Leon.

They were sure now it couldn’t be anyone other than young master Leon himself. Their doubts were clear as to who the man was who looked almost similar to the young master, besides his mystical eyes and older age.
But now, seeing a man even older than before, they knew young master Leon had somehow grown up.
And their master was just like usual, behaving with him the same way she usually did.
So they continued their work while taking glances at them from time to time.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Dream Empire
paragraphs: But soon, to the maids’ surprise, an even greater shock returned to their faces as they could now hear the slurping sound of their passionate kiss, which was going on in the background. It wasn’t just that they had just seen it, but it was clear as day to them—their lips connecting to each other as they latched onto each other.
Slurp~
Slurp~
Slurp~
Their work continued with the background noises of slurping sounds.
After their work, they left right afterward, with every maid inside the room having the thought that they had to share this with every other maid in the mansion.

Her lady hadn’t told them anything and did these things with young master Leon in front of them without any care, which meant they were never supposed to be a secret. So news fell faster than anything to the whole mansion, filled with trusted people of Seraphine, about young master Leon’s new appearance.
The shocking news of Lady Seraphine and young master Leon’s forbidden relationship.
They separated from each other, finally, after a few kisses and hugs, which Seraphine needed, and Leon wasn’t far off—he had missed so much, as unlike her, he was away for the whole 9 months.
After finishing their breakfast, Seraphine led him to the training like usual. Both of them changed from thier casual clothes to thier training outfits.
Which was a black tight upper body suit made of an elastic yet durable material, the same could be said for the tight-skinned pants, along with them.
Leon looked at her, seeing her like this, no matter how many times he sees her, he can’t get enough of her sexy appearance.
Seraphine didn’t try to tease him. It would have felt great to her to change in front of him, but she didn’t want to distract him before the fight.
There was no one inside the training hall besides both of them, as usual. He took out the dimensional hourglass from his inventory without any worry.
The moment it appeared in his hand, floating slightly along with glowing sand moving sideways, while having the appearance of a normal hourglass, Seraphine knew it was far from any normal hourglass.
Leon looked at her and said, "Are you ready to go, master?"
"Yes, I can’t wait to fight you," she expressed.
Leon showed a lighthearted, loving smile, but his voice was serious.
"Master, I do get that you want to fight a strong opponent and your disciple, but let me warn you, I am not going to go easy on you, and I think you will lose today."
Seraphine heard him and replied on the same serious note.
"My disciple, you don’t have to worry about that. Just be careful, you are too shy when you lose to me."
Does Seraphine think she can lose to him?

The answer was yes. Knowing first hand what he was capable of, he had stats higher than hers, mana almost ten times hers. In a prolonged battle, there was no chance for her. She also didn’t think he had wasted any time to learn the elements he had.
She believed her chances of winning were lower than her chances of losing.

But in reality, she didn’t care much what the outcome of the battle would be. She wanted to fight with him when he was close to her power level, because she knew in the future he would be too strong to ever catch up to him.

After hearing about her potential from him, which was a worry to her, it made her relieved, she knew her goal was to get a better class in the higher realm and reach the lesser divine realm, like he had mentioned— which she had enough potential to reach.

She didn’t know where he got such detailed knowledge. He told her it was due to an item he had bought from the special shop function of his system, but he never showed it to her. Instead, he told her every bit of knowledge contained within.
She appreciated her disciple’s sweet gesture quite a lot.
Instead of the item itself, it was much better to just listen to her, Leon’s sweet voice.

Her goal was to reach the lesser divine realm, which would give her endless life and let her live forever with her Leon. She didn’t need anything more in her life, but she knew she had to work hard to achieve that.
She was never afraid of challenges, and this was one she would complete, as living forever with her Leon would be the most beautiful dream she could even muster.
Hearing her answer, Leon started to pour his mana into the hourglass, and in less than a minute, a shimmering silver-white portal appeared in front of him.
Leon took the hand of Seraphine, ensuring that they would be together as he hadn’t done this before, and jumped right into the portal along with her.
He noticed that he had entered the same place as before, like it was supposed to be, and beside him, Seraphine was also fine.

Seraphine was in her own world as she looked at the vast expanse of endless rocky mountains around her. Beyond it, her vision could not see, but she could see that these mountains were not the end of the scope of his dimension. The sky was strange—there was no sun, moon, or anything, even though it was close to sunset.
Which she didn’t think would change.

Seeing the capability of an actual mythical ranked item, Seraphine realized how truly divine his treasure was. The first thing that came to her mind was to explore the land, see how vast it was, and then build a city, a kingdom, or even an empire there.

She didn’t know what her disciple thought in this regard, but she could imagine him being a loner, but she was quite the opposite. No matter how strong you are, if you have capable people to work for you, things would be much nicer.

Their ambitions were high—reaching the lower divine for her, and for Leon, it might be even higher. She wanted to build her own empire here, her Leon as a king, she as his wife, the queen, with a massive army of their own and hundreds of thousands of loyal people under them, or even millions.
Her spine tingled just from imagining the sight in her mind.

She remembered he had a treasure, which she thought was ranked quite low for the thing it was capable of—the miraculous spoon of infinite soup, which would create endless delicious, perfectly balanced soup, might be a dream meal for quite a lot of people in the entire lower domain.

She had seen the vision and potential in this place. She was going to build an empire for her Leon right here, making full use of his treasures, and make him a worthy emperor who ruled all these people.
Who would help them along their journey, as their eyes, ears, and sword, if they had to, with their loyalty toward them as their driving force?

It wasn’t just that they had just seen it, but it was clear as day to them—their lips connecting to each other as they latched onto each other.
Slurp~
Slurp~
Slurp~
Their work continued with the background noises of slurping sounds.
After their work, they left right afterward, with every maid inside the room having the thought that they had to share this with every other maid in the mansion.
Her lady hadn’t told them anything and did these things with young master Leon in front of them without any care, which meant they were never supposed to be a secret.

The shocking news of Lady Seraphine and young master Leon’s forbidden relationship.
They separated from each other, finally, after a few kisses and hugs, which Seraphine needed, and Leon wasn’t far off—he had missed so much, as unlike her, he was away for the whole 9 months.

Both of them changed from thier casual clothes to thier training outfits.

Seraphine didn’t try to tease him.

Leon looked at her and said, "Are you ready to go, master?"
"Yes, I can’t wait to fight you," she expressed.
Leon showed a lighthearted, loving smile, but his voice was serious.
"Master, I do get that you want to fight a strong opponent and your disciple, but let me warn you, I am not going to go easy on you, and I think you will lose today."

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Fight, Leon vs Seraphine
paragraphs: Seraphine was most confident in winning people’s hearts and ruling over them. The scale seemed a bit too high, but she was ready for it.
The fight was important to her, but the vision she had imagined in her mind was an even greater goal of her life now than this fight for self-fulfillment.
She also noticed that now the mana inside was so abundant in nature. Even still, her focus was caught more by the future possibility this dimension held.
Leon’s sudden nudge at her shoulder made her come out of her reverie.
"Master, have you lost yourself in the beauty of a mythical ranked treasure?"
Seraphine nodded to his words, but she wouldn’t tell him anything about her plan now, as right now they had to focus on their fight.
"Are you ready to fight your master for the first time, disciple?" she asked.
"Yes." Leon moved forward and planted a kiss on her soft lips and continued. "Master, whether the outcome of battle falls to you or me, always remember I love you no matter what."
"I know." She planted a kiss of her own in response to his kiss. "Whether I win or lose today, I will always love you, Leon, and nothing could ever change that."
After these words were exchanged, the atmosphere between them thickened.

Somewhere inside the time dimension, a lady with white eyes looked at the screen in front of her. She couldn’t tell what they were talking about—there was no sound from the screen from which she was observing them.

But the moment she had noticed her perverted master coming inside along with the beautiful lady holding his arm, she was proud and, more importantly, excited and lucky. She had just thought that her master would bring a girl here and do those things with her here. It would be very interesting for her to watch.
And her wish came true.
"Hehe~ that’s what I expect from my horny master, who can jerk off all day. He had gone for the kiss right after they entered. He’s such a pervert."

However, the next moment, both of them separated from each other in an instant. Leon took out his uncommonly ranked sword from his inventory and unsheathed it, and Seraphine, who was carrying her weapon, also a sword of the same rank as his, which amplified the lightning-infused attacks.
She knew how to use a spear, too, but as her main weapon, she was most confident in her swordsmanship.
Both of them used their mana enhancement technique at the same time—Leon using his adept rank mana enhancement and Seraphine her master rank mana enhancement.

Their eyes were locked on each other all the time. Suddenly, both their figures vanished from the place, as in the next instant, in the middle, their swords collided with each other, creating a loud metallic sound.
Clang!
The ancient lady with the white eyes was looking at the screen as their first clash of swords happened and sparks were created. Her mouth twitched seeing the scene in front of her.
The fight wasn’t boring as entertainment was a luxury in this confined space. However, she was pissed at her horny master.

Despite being so horny and alone, after the first kiss they had started fighting each other for some reason. The fact that she couldn’t even hear what they talked about earlier made her even more pissed.

Watching her handsome but horny master, who was a sex machine, fucking that beautiful purple haired woman would have been a thousand times more entertaining to her than watching two children fighting each other.

She had never been like this before. Watching mortals indulge in pleasure—she had never watched it before she was caged here, but after living in this place confined for hundreds of thousands of years, her sense of entertainment had shifted from her previous hobbies.

And the first greatest stimulus for her was when she had seen her future master beating his 9-inch-long meat for a day straight. It was exhilarating for her to watch—she never got bored during that time.

His different expressions every time he came, the methods he used to make it more entertaining, using both hands sometimes, even one, the pacing, the rhythms—it had been in her mind since she had watched it for the first time.
This made her curious about what it would be like when he mated with other humans.
But the current sight instead of doing what she had expected from him, he had started a fight with the human woman for some reason.
"Master, you are hopeless..."

Both of them were surprised by how they blocked each other’s attack. Leon was too, as he had gained a total of 6 physical stat increases in the past nine months, which he knew was very fast compared to what he heard from his master.
So he gave credit to his body being transformed after merging with the orb.

At the same time, he understood that being a master rank in mana body enhancement gave you massive bonuses. He was around 6-7 stats higher than her in every physical stat, despite that they were matched.
No, she was faster than he, but Seraphine didn’t know Leon’s spatial awareness was active all the time. He was predicting her attacks to block them in time.

Leon didn’t use anything else and continued fighting with her with his sword, as fighting like this with her was helping him merge his knowledge and integrate it into his swordsmanship even more flawlessly.
Seraphine noticed that change too, as he was getting better and better with his sword. He was barely catching up to her at first, but now his skills were matching her own.

She couldn’t let it continue like this. This was not training where she was teaching him—this was a fight, and even with the fact that her mana was recovering much faster here, she knew she couldn’t continue it like this with his monstrous mana reserves.
Her eyes became sharp as she was ready to start using her skills and techniques if she wanted to finish this quickly.

Midway through the next clash that happened, she used her level 52 uncommon-ranked lightning steps skill. Lightning flashed around her body, arriving in front of him in an instant. Leon barely registered her movement with his spatial awareness, moved back to dodge her thrust out of her weapon’s range.
But when he thought he dodged the attack, a piercing force from the tip of her sword shot forward it blasting his body back a few meters.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Fight, Leon vs Seraphine (2)
paragraphs: Leon’s feetscreechedagainst the rocky surface, and a painful sensation shot through his upper body, focused more so in his abdomen, where a 2-inch deep hole was created.
Screee—CHUNK!
Urgh
Only a grunt escaped his mouth, as he was already used to pain by now, because of his training on himself with his life element and past torturous experiences in the dungeon.

He hadn’t had any time to even think properly when he sensed her next attack coming from his back. This attack felt more terrifying than the last one. Leon didn’t take any chances and teleported himself 10 meters away from her.
Zzt—BOOM!
He had used his life element to heal himself properly.

But what terrified him was the fact that he had seen his master’s next attack landing on the ground from above. A terrified lightning revolving around her bladescreeched like an enraged bansheeas it landed on the ground,exploding with a thunderous CRACK—KA-BOOM!Rocks flew in all directions, the impactblasted a small crater, crackswebbingthrough the solid ground like lightning frozen in stone.
If he hadn’t dodged that attack, he would have had a deep wound, and if it continued with the same intensity, he would have lost to her then and there.
But seeing her attack landing on the ground and there was no one there, it surprised her a lot. At the same time, she felt ignited to know he had dodged that.

As this combo of hers was enough to finish most opponents, or render them helpless, she knew after her piercing thrust landed on him as a surprise, how tough his body was, so she wasn’t worried that it would cause him a fatal injury.
She had used another lightning step to not give him time to even breathe, and thenthe Skybreaker Drawtechnique to finish the fight, or so she thought.

Her eyes locked on him, standing 10 meters away from her. She didn’t charge, she noticed his wounds were already gone, which wasn’t a surprise to her as last night he had told her not to hold back—he had learned to use life element and could even heal fatal wounds with his mana reserves.

She had used almost one-tenth of her whole reserve just now. The reason she didn’t attack was to let her mana recover, and this time she was gonna use an even more terrifying combo, and she had even taken into consideration his ability to vanish in just half a second.
She knew what she had to do—just had to be faster than that.
Leon looked at his master, who was looking at him with the eyes of a hunter who was watching her prey.

After just this little battle, he had understood that in a real fight, he shouldn’t try to learn and go with the intention to finish it as quickly as possible, like how his master was trying to achieve.
"Master, be ready," he said with a light smile on his face. "Don’t worry, master, I will heal back to new when I am done with you."
"I will finish this quickly, so we should go on our date. I don’t like fighting with you, honestly."

Seraphine, hearing his words, was alert now, as now she knew her disciple would show her what he was capable of—not the unrefined swordsplay he had shown earlier, which made her realize the greatness of having this treasure of time, as he had just switched his weapon.
His confidence had irked her a bit as if he was sure she wouldn’t be able to do anything, but she would show him what true years of experience are.
Yet it made her feel warm that he was as excited as her for the date. She replied to him.
"Don’t worry, my disciple, I feel the same, so the master is gonna finish this fast."
After they said their final words, the silence fell, and it was broken by Leon as he released an onslaught of powerful lightning strikes every 0.25 seconds.
ZAP—ZAP—ZAP—ZAAAP!!
To dodge these attacks, Seraphine had to activate herRaijin Descent, one of the most powerful techniques of hers, as two horns made out of lightning formed up from her skull.
CRRK-KRAK!
Her body flared withmana body enhancementandlightning stepskill.
FWOOSH—BOOM!

She had become terrifyingly fast. Leon could only see her blurred figure as she was trying to close the distance between them. With his spatial awareness, Leon, even when he couldn’t see her, could predict the trajectory of her path as he bombarded them with tens of light bolts, which he could cast almost infinitely with his recovery speed in here.
When it felt she was coming closer, he would teleport back,
Zzt!—CRASH!
Making Seraphine realize how deadly this trap she had been caught in was—he wasn’t even breaking a sweat, and at this rate, in a couple of minutes, her entire mana reserve would be over.
She couldn’t afford to delay this fight any longer. She had to finish it quickly if she wanted to win.

She activated her level oneLightning Auraat the same time as herThunder Vein Pulsetechnique to detect where his attacks would come from, so she could reach him quickly and didn’t just rely on her enhanced speed.
While using Aura didn’t take as much mana as skills and techniques, even with that, she could only last in this state for two minutes with her mana.
Crackling blue lightningaround her sword and body, her pressuring aura and two lightning horns on her head, at the same time, her mana body enhancement master rank is at full capacity right now.
CRACK-CRACK-CRACK!
This was her strongest form.
Just when her Aura unleashed itself, Leon felt the change in atmosphere. Along with lightning strikes, he had decided to use the ice affinity to launch large skewers of ice at her.
SHIIING—WHOOSH!—SHHHK!

She dodged them as if nothing—it looked to him her figure had just blinked out of sight. Leon realized the seriousness of the situation. Her speed was too much for him to handle now. He used both his lightning element and wind element to enhance his speed at the same time, and teleported even before she had made her next move.
VWOOOM!
And as expected, as he vanished from the previous spot, Seraphine was already there with a sword strike that made a long, deep cut on the rocky surface as if cutting butter.
CLANG—KRRRRRRAK!
Leon knew he would have lost his arms if he hadn’t teleported in time.

And now with his wind and lightning element enhancing his speed, he was confident in dodging whatever she threw at him. In her current state, he wasn’t a match for her in a head-on fight, so he couldn’t afford to take a hit from her—it would be over.

Seraphine tried everything, but he would barely dodge her every single time. There was only one minute left for her now in her strongest state. She knew—at this rate, it was really over. She wouldn’t be able to win this fight and would collapse from mana exhaustion.
She had lost. Her disciple was impossible to catch. But she wasn’t going to give up just yet.
All she needed was one opening. Just one.
So instead of attacking—she spoke.
"Leon, are you just gonna run like this... or actually try to attack me?"
